meta_description:
3,813 likes, 39 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "⁠Boulders Beach in South Africa is home to a famous colony of African penguins. 🐧 The sheltered coves have calm water, large granite boulders, and views of the birds as they move between the rocks and sea.⁠
⁠
The colony first arrived here in 1982 and has since become one of Cape Town’s most famous attractions.".
